chiru: Kieini kar a hawng rupum chawngshok hai chungchanga rishim miejiekna rang mi tampui na rurashak uh.
english: Inasmuch as many have taken in hand to set in order a narrative of those things which have been fulfilled among us

chiru: Putna a mik a muk a kungruchang hai le athachawng shepding ruchang hai kha na kieini dieng khut inururotho pui u tak kha le raang
english: just as those who from the beginning were eyewitnesses and ministers of the word delivered them to us

chiru: richitawm Aw Theophilus kiei na kung ah put ah riringtak a kihawngjui rikip kha nang dieng dawdawn a kimiejiek rang a hi kiei naawm atha tia koloi.
english: it seemed good to me also having had perfect understanding of all things from the very first to write to you an orderly account most excellent Theophilus

chiru: Makha mi na nang dieng a inururuchuk chawng hai chungchanga adik kha rupumping a nangjetna rang a inih.
english: that you may know the certainty of those things in which you were instructed

chiru: Judea reng Herod rong khan Zacharias iti thiempu khat ruawm. Ama kha Abijah rui a rushok inih. Unungak kha Elizabeth iti Aaron tunu hai kar a akhat runih.
english: There was in the days of Herod the king of Judea a certain priest named Zacharias of the division of Abijah. His wife was of the daughters of Aaron and her name was Elizabeth

chiru: Adinre kha Pathien maikung a midik runih uh. Amani na Pumi chawngpek hai le ridikna hai kholok kha jui jarkhan metekna awm boipet a ruring uh.
english: And they were both righteous before God walking in all the commandments and ordinances of the Lord blameless

chiru: Khania Elizabeth kha nairong runih jarkhan amani na nai runiei u mak. Adinre kha kumletha na rulim u joi.
english: But they had no child because Elizabeth was barren and they were both well advanced in years

chiru: Nikhat hin Zacharias na Pathien maikung a ama thiempu thoi thawna rang ama lawmdawn Thiempumun shena dungjuia
english: So it was that while he was serving as priest before God in the order of his division

chiru: ama na Pumi riethiengmun rulut a berawh ha rang vanmuk en a ama chung a rucho pe. Berawh kha ruhalai khan mipui ruchun kha na vai tieng nikna niei a ruawm uh.
english: according to the custom of the priesthood his lot fell to burn incense when he went into the temple of the Lord. And the whole multitude of the people was praying outside at the hour of incense

chiru: Berawh hana maicham chang tieng khan Pumi ravantir khat na ama dieng rular.
english: Then an angel of the Lord appeared to him standing on the right side of the altar of incense

chiru: Khan Zacharias na ama kha rumuk phakhan rurawnawk khan chitna kha na ama kha rumukhu.
english: And when Zacharias saw him he was troubled and fear fell upon him

chiru: Khan ravantir na ama dieng ruti Chih naw roh Zacharias ajarla nanginik kha Pathien na rangai joi. Nang inkonu Elizabeth na nang rang shapa khat niei rangnih. Ama riming kha John nangti pe rangnih.
english: But the angel said to him Do not be afraid Zacharias for your prayer is heard and your wife Elizabeth will bear you a son and you shall call his name John

chiru: Ama kha nang rang rawshawna le mapakna chang rangnih. Khan ama shok phakhan mi tampui ningai rangnih.
english: And you will have joy and gladness and many will rejoice at his birth

chiru: Ajarla Pumi maikung a ama kha lur rangnih. Khan itikte nitaawm ama na ju ninawkle khawpnathiei ju neh naw nih. Unu vawn shungshe khan Ratha Riethieng le ship rangnih.
english: For he will be great in the sight of the Lord and shall drink neither wine nor strong drink. He will also be filled with the Holy Spirit even from his mothers womb

chiru: Ama na Israel miring tampui hi amani Pumi Pathien dieng hawng mikir rangnih.
english: And he will turn many of the children of Israel to the Lord their God

chiru: Elijah ratha le ranak khan Pumi maikung a lawn rangnih. Makha apa hai mulung kha nai hai dieng hieina rang chawngjui boi kha midik lungvar dieng hieina rang khan Pumi rang a rasham miring konna rang a inih.
english: He will also go before Him in the spirit and power of Elijah to turn the hearts of the fathers to the children and the disobedient to the wisdom of the just to make ready a people prepared for the Lord

chiru: Khan Zacharias na ravantir dieng ruti Mahi kiei na itia maw jet ning? Ajarla kiei hi atar khat kanih joi khan kiinkonuawm kumletha na alim joi.
english: And Zacharias said to the angel How shall I know this? For I am an old man and my wife is well advanced in years

chiru: Ravantir na mashang a ruti Kiei hi Pathien maikung a ading Gabriel kha kanih. Kiei hi nang dieng chawngriei rang le mahi ningaina chawng rophong rang a inojongtir inih.
english: And the angel answered and said to him I am Gabriel who stands in the presence of God and was sent to speak to you and bring you these glad tidings

chiru: Khania enro pha dungjuia hawng rupum rang a kawchawng hai khan takanangshawn boi jarkhan nang heshok boi a awm rang nangnih khan hihai kholok hi shok masheng nang chawng ngamlai naw tinih.
english: But behold you will be mute and not able to speak until the day these things take place because you did not believe my words which will be fulfilled in their own time

chiru: Khan mi hai na Zacharias kha rungak a ruawm uh. Riethiengmun ah put ah vak shumhai jarkhan shindawngna runiei uh.
english: And the people waited for Zacharias and marveled that he lingered so long in the temple

chiru: Ama na vak shok phakhan amani dieng herusho thieilai mak. Riethiengmun ah mulungmik imuk keng joi iti kha amani na rujet uh. Ajarla ama na jetna hai kha ruthaw khan hesho thiei boi a ruawm joi.
english: But when he came out he could not speak to them and they perceived that he had seen a vision in the temple for he beckoned to them and remained speechless

chiru: Khan hitihin rushok ama richichon thawna nikho hai kha ruhek phakhan iin ah rushe joi.
english: So it was as soon as the days of his service were completed that he departed to his own house

chiru: Khan khahai nikho shole iinkonu Elizabeth na nairuvawng joi khan tha rahnga dawr hi bitlam a ruawm.
english: Now after those days his wife Elizabeth conceived and she hid herself five months saying

chiru: Ama na ruti Pumi na kiei hi neen phakhan hihaihi ithaw inih. Makha mi hai kar a maimawkna kha kiei ah put ah noloina pe rang a inih.
english: Thus the Lord has dealt with me in the days when He looked on me to take away my reproach among people

chiru: Tha ruk changna khan Nazareth iti Galilee ah awm kho khat ah Pathien na ravantir Gabriel kha David inshung a awm Joseph iti rothar khat na ishot shimnu khat dieng rutir.
english: Now in the sixth month the angel Gabriel was sent by God to a city of Galilee named Nazareth

chiru: Khan shimnu riming kha Mariam ruti.
english: to a virgin betrothed to a man whose name was Joseph of the house of David. The virgins name was Mary

chiru: Ama dieng she a ruti Pathien na imiritnu chubai. Pumi na nang kha nawrawtawp pui joi. Nang hi nupang hai kar a rahvantha nangnih!
english: And having come in the angel said to her Rejoice highly favored one the Lord is with you blessed are you among women

chiru: Khania ama chawng hai khan rurawnawk a mahi ih chat chubai maw nih tia rumining.
english: But when she saw him she was troubled at his saying and considered what manner of greeting this was

chiru: Ravantir na ama dieng ruti Chih naw roh Mariam ajarla nang na Pathien miritna kha nangmuk joi.
english: Then the angel said to her Do not be afraid Mary for you have found favor with God

chiru: Enro nang na nai nangvawng a shapa khat nangniei rangnih. Ama riming kha Jesu nangti pe rangnih.
english: And behold you will conceive in your womb and bring forth a Son and shall call His name Jesus

chiru: Ama kha lur rangnih khan ama kha Rashang chungchon Shapa ti rangnih. Pumi Pathien na ama dieng apa David rengshutna kha pek rangnih.
english: He will be great and will be called the Son of the Highest and the Lord God will give Him the throne of His father David

chiru: Khan hektiknieiboi a Jacob inshung a ama na reng chang rangnih. Ama rengchangna kha kumshawt a awm rangnih.
english: And He will reign over the house of Jacob forever and of His kingdom there will be no end

chiru: Mariam na ravantir dieng ruti Kiei apa le rishih boipet a mahi itia maw nithiei nih?
english: Then Mary said to the angel How can this be since I do not know a man

chiru: Ravantir na mashang a ama dieng ruti Ratha Riethieng na nang dieng jong rangnih khan Rashang chungchon ranak kha na nang kha nirilip rangnih. Khajarkhan Nai Riethieng nanginiei rang a kha Pathien Shapa ti rangnih.
english: And the angel answered and said to her The Holy Spirit will come upon you and the power of the Highest will overshadow you therefore also that Holy One who is to be born will be called the Son of God

chiru: Enro nang shokpuinu Elizabeth ama naawm atar tieng shapa khat vawng joi. Nairong itinu u kha tun tha ruk nih joi. Ajarla Pathien le anithiei boi iti awm mak.
english: Now indeed Elizabeth your relative has also conceived a son in her old age and this is now the sixth month for her who was called barren. For with God nothing will be impossible

chiru: Khashole Mariam na ruti Enro kiei hi Pumi shoknu kha kanih! Nangiriei dungjuia kiei dieng ashok nih rosho. Khan ravantir kha ama ah put ah rushe joi.
english: Then Mary said Behold the maidservant of the Lord! Let it be to me according to your word. And the angel departed from her

chiru: Khalaikhan Mariam na ruthoi a mo ram Judea khopui khan nawtshun a ruhawng joi.
english: Now Mary arose in those days and went into the hill country with haste to a city of Judah

chiru: Kha mun khan ama na Zacharias in ah rulut a Elizabeth kha chubai rupek.
english: and entered the house of Zacharias and greeted Elizabeth

chiru: Khan hitihin rushok Elizabeth na Mariam chubai kha rujet phakhan anaikawk ah nai kha ruchawm pe. Khan Elizabeth kha Ratha Riethieng na jong ship joi.
english: And it happened when Elizabeth heard the greeting of Mary that the babe leaped in her womb and Elizabeth was filled with the Holy Spirit

chiru: Elizabeth na he rashangtak a ruraai a ruti Nupang hai kar a nang rahvantha nangnih nang naikawk ara kha rahvantha inih!
english: Then she spoke out with a loud voice and said Blessed are you among women and blessed is the fruit of your womb

chiru: Khan kupumi unu nang na kiei dieng nangva hi itia shok maw nih?
english: But why is this granted to me that the mother of my Lord should come to me

chiru: Ajarla nang chubai pek hesho kha kejetphit le kanaikawk ah nai hi na rawshaw a ruchawm.
english: For indeed as soon as the voice of your greeting sounded in my ears the babe leaped in my womb for joy

chiru: Khan Pumi na ama dieng a iruriei kha rupum rangnih tia takashawn ama kha rahvanmuh miring kha inih.
english: Blessed is she who believed for there will be a fulfillment of those things which were told her from the Lord

chiru: Khan Mariam na ruti Kiringphuk na Pumi kha mielien khan karatha na kashandampa Pathien jar a ningai.
english: And Mary said My soul magnifies the Lord And my spirit has rejoiced in God my Savior

chiru: Hijarhin ama shoknu adawk awmchan kha jet joi. Ajarla enro tun ah put ah rong kholok na kiei hi rahvanmuh tia nokoi rangnih joi.
english: For He has regarded the lowly state of His maidservant For behold henceforth all generations will call me blessed

chiru: Hijarhin Ranaknieipa kha na kiei dieng chon lientak thaw joi. Ama riming kha riethieng inih.
english: For He who is mighty has done great things for me And holy is His name

chiru: Ama achih miring hai dieng rongrong a ama roihoina kha awm.
english: And His mercy is on those who fear Him From generation to generation

chiru: Ama banbo kha le aranak kha rumumuk amani mulungmining a lienrasha hai kha rangrang a rutet.
english: He has shown strength with His arm He has scattered the proud in the imagination of their hearts

chiru: Ranakniei hai kha rengmun ah put ah rumocho khan rede hai kha ama na alawm.
english: He has put down the mighty from their thrones And exalted the lowly

chiru: Vawncham hai kha nekleshak atha hai kha le rumiship khan rawchawng miring hai kha rok a rumikir.
english: He has filled the hungry with good things And the rich He has sent away empty

chiru: Ama roihoina miningna khan ama shok Israel kha rushan joi. Makha napa u hai dieng Abraham dieng le ama chicha hai dieng kumshawt a chawng iruriei dungjuia ashok inih.
english: He has helped His servant Israel In remembrance of His mercy As He spoke to our fathers To Abraham and to his seed forever

chiru: Khan Mariam na Elizabeth le tha thum dawr ruawm a iin ah rukir joi.
english: And Mary remained with her about three months and returned to her house

chiru: Khan Elizabeth na nai inieina rang a pha kha hawng rupum pe a ama na shapa khat runiei joi.
english: Now Elizabeths full time came for her to be delivered and she brought forth a son

chiru: Pumi na ama chung a roihoina lientak irutetna kha ringchangpui le inkoshangram hai kha na rujet ua ama le ningrungaishom uh.
english: When her neighbors and relatives heard how the Lord had shown great mercy to her they rejoiced with her

chiru: Khan hitihin rushok ni riet changna khan amani na naitepa vunepna rang le apa riming moloh a Zacharias tia riming phona rang rushe uh.
english: So it was on the eighth day that they came to circumcise the child and they would have called him by the name of his father Zacharias

chiru: Inia unu na rumashang Nimak ama riming John tia pho pe rang a inih.
english: His mother answered and said No he shall be called John

chiru: Amani na ama dieng ruti uh Nang shokpui hai kar a tute na mahi riming hi pho maklai.
english: But they said to her There is no one among your relatives who is called by this name

chiru: Amani na apa dieng itia maw koi jawt iti jetna rang ama dieng jetna rupek uh.
english: So they made signs to his father what he would have him called

chiru: Ama na miejiekna rang lungpek khat runik khan rumiejiek a ruti Ama riming hi John inih. Makhan amani lawpsheng a shindawngna runiei uh.
english: And he asked for a writing tablet and wrote saying His name is John So they all marveled

chiru: Khan relentak a Pathien na abai kha rumawlawng pe a iemieliei kha ruthut pe joi. Khan ama na achawng ruput a Pathien kha rumapak joi.
english: Immediately his mouth was opened and his tongue loosed and he spoke praising God

chiru: Ringchangpui kholok dieng chitna kha jong shok khan Judea lawn ah awm mi kholok na chonshok jar a ruriei uh.
english: Then fear came on all who dwelt around them and all these sayings were discussed throughout all the hill country of Judea

chiru: Ajet hai mi rikip na amani mulungmining a ruti uh Mahi naitepa hi imaw hawng rachang nih? Khatikhan Pumi khut kha ama le rurawtawp.
english: And all those who heard them kept them in their hearts saying What kind of child will this be? And the hand of the Lord was with him

chiru: Khan apa Zacharias kha Ratha Riethieng na jongship khan chawng rurophong a ruti
english: Now his father Zacharias was filled with the Holy Spirit and prophesied saying

chiru: Israel Pumi Pathien kha rahvantha inih hijarhin ama na nojong phak a ama miring hai rang khekna chon kha jong thaw joi.
english: Blessed is the Lord God of Israel For He has visited and redeemed His people

chiru: Khan ama shok David inshung a shandamna riki kha kieini rang mothoi joi. Makha rong put ah put ah ama thiempulien riethieng hai bai a chawng irurieitak kha dungjuia ashok inih.
english: And has raised up a horn of salvation for us In the house of His servant David As He spoke by the mouth of His holy prophets Who have been since the world began

chiru: Ama na naraha pui hai ah put ah le namumah hai khut ah put ah nashan rangnih.
english: That we should be saved from our enemies And from the hand of all who hate us

chiru: Khatikhan ama na napa hai dieng a chawngirurakham roihoina kha numumuk joi. Ama rawjawtna riethieng kha mininghep joi.
english: To perform the mercy promised to our fathers And to remember His holy covenant

chiru: Napa u Abraham dieng chawngirurakham kha: Narahapui hai khut ah put ah nurukhek jarkhan kieini na chih boipet a ama chon nawthawna pe rang a inih.
english: The oath which He swore to our father Abraham To grant us that we Being delivered from the hand of our enemies Might serve Him without fear

chiru: Makha amaikung a riethieng a le dikna khan niringlailim chon thawna rang a inih.
english: In holiness and righteousness before Him all the days of our life

chiru: Khan naitepa nang hi Rashang chungchon thiempulien tia koi rangnih. Ajarla Pumi maton ah ama Lam hai kha arasham rang she rang nangnih.
english: And you child will be called the prophet of the Highest For you will go before the face of the Lord to prepare His ways

chiru: Munu hai rangaidamna jar a shandamna varna kha imiring hai pekna rang a inih.
english: To give knowledge of salvation to His people By the remission of their sins

chiru: Pathien roihoina renem jar a rashang ah put ah nuchung ua Ni shok joi. Makha ajing le thitna rilip a awm amani dieng mieivar pekna rang a inih.
english: Through the tender mercy of our God With which the Dayspring from on high has visited us To give light to those who sit in darkness and the shadow of death

chiru: Lungdamna lam a neke u hai kha lamnakaina pe rang a inih.
english: To guide our feet into the way of peace

chiru: Naitepa kha hawng rawshawn a ratha a hawng rat joi. Khan Israel miring hai dieng ama vanoichon kha ruput masheng ama na ramthim ah ruawm.
english: So the child grew and became strong in spirit and was in the deserts till the day of his manifestation to Israel
